title: The Mitch Protocol
description: The version of you that talks easily already exists. The Mitch Protocol is the complete system for stepping into your most socially confident and adaptable self, Mitch, in any room, until Mitch is just you.
waitlistIncludes: Exact scenarios: someone you're attracted to, a group mid-conversation, a boss, a party where you know one person, a cold room, being watched
Full dialogues, including the ones that went badly
A rep schedule that turns it into default behavior
How to stop needing the name

proof.text: Kids who did a hard task as "Batman" focused longer and performed better than kids who did it as themselves.
Coaching yourself with your own name instead of "I" improves clarity and lowers stress reactivity in under a second.
Pre-set if-then plans roughly tripled follow-through across 94 studies.
People feel a spotlight about twice as bright as the one actually on them.
